path.title: A text, image, or video request enters the Lab2Sim agent
Retrieved manufacturer evidence is frozen into the asset spec
The frozen spec drives articulated USD generation
Generated USD is handed to ConvertAsset
ConvertAsset-qualified USD becomes a robot-ready Isaac scene
